title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Choosing Between Hot, Cold, and Custodial Wallets

questions.text: Which type of wallet keeps private keys completely offline?
questions.explanation: A cold wallet is a physical hardware device that keeps private keys completely offline.

questions.text: True or false: With a custodial wallet, a third party holds your private keys.
questions.explanation: True. In a custodial wallet, a third party, usually a centralized exchange, holds the private keys for you.
